purpose: Derived cost per 1K requests and weight footprint (D41). No request was made.

assumptions.gpu_rate_source: the A10 rate the GPU sessions were budgeted at — not an invoice
assumptions.local_throughput_source: runs/m1_serving.json — a 246 s burst at concurrency 16 over the same 5,800 pairs, not a saturation test
assumptions.frontier_source: data/router/frontier_cache.jsonl — token counts of the F8 run, one row per pair, priced at list

local.per_task_note: M1 measured pooled throughput only; per-task GPU cost is not separable from it

same_workload.reading: local is cheaper only while sustained load exceeds break_even_rps; the ratio holds only at M1's throughput with no idle time
not_included: the quality difference — GPT-4o-mini scores lower on these tasks

footprint.note: safetensors file sizes at the pinned revisions; not GPU memory

not_measured.gpu_memory_at_serving: no nvidia-smi or vLLM memory figure was recorded
not_measured.frontier_latency: the F8 run recorded tokens, not timings
